title: Hivestorm component diagram
description: Hivestorm, an arcade shooter: the client plays the game, and the Worker replays each submitted game from its recorded controls before it goes on the table.

components.name: Hivestorm
components.responsibility: One game: the browser client and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Browser game
components.responsibility: The engine, drawing, input, sound, menus and, where it has them, online play.

components.name: High-score Worker
components.responsibility: The high-score API and public scores page; replays each game before listing it.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at icelander.net/games (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in, /me, the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.

relationships.description: Asks for a seed (POST api/game), submits the game (POST api/score) and loads the table (GET api/scores).
Replays games with src/engine/replay.ts and cleans names with src/name.ts.
Joins online games through the relay WebSocket.
